title: A product's acts file
description: One row for every act a person can do in the product. bin/check-acts.mjs checks it against acts/CONTRACT.md. The answer (read, alone, card, open) is never a field: it is computed from the facts. The schema holds the shape only; what a field may hold is checked by the rule of the same name in acts/CONTRACT.md.

screens.description: The screen ids of the product: every row names one.

areas.description: The closed list of areas find_acts filters by.

census.description: The product's three tests (act-census): the census (code list equals rows), the dry do_act for every row, the eager array and prompt bytes.

source.description: What the census matches: METHOD and path, a command, a skill folder, or a module function.

what.description: One plain line for the model, 20 to 140 characters; the same text every turn.

words.description: Synonyms in English, Hindi and Hinglish that find_acts ranks by.

input.description: One strict JSON Schema, or { from: <the product's own schema name> }.

pick.description: A read row: the field paths kept from the answer.

cap.description: A read row: the most characters of one fact, at most 4000.

holds_secret.description: The answer holds a field of the secret class that cannot be picked away: the row is then a never row (open), not a read.

undo.description: The act id that takes this act back; only for facts.undo true.

raise.description: The facts the server looks up itself at the call and may only turn on: spends, seen, other, spoken.

tool.description: The eager tool and action that also does this act.
